capabilities: Copy markdown links to headings, inserting stable block IDs or HTML anchors for duplicate headings
Rename a heading and update matching wiki, markdown, and HTML links in a file, folder, or the whole vault
Find references to a heading and jump to each match in context
Rename a heading and its references directly from the Find References modal
Configure link path format, link label template, duplicate target format, and rename scope
extras: Commands register without default hotkeys and only trigger when the cursor is on a heading line; renaming cannot produce headings containing |, ], or line breaks because wikilinks cannot escape them.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's native heading links can break when headings are renamed, and finding every reference can be tedious.
motivation: The author built it because Obsidian's native heading links can break on rename and finding every reference manually is tedious.
problem: Obsidian's native heading links break when headings are renamed, and finding every reference to a heading is tedious.
summary: Heading-link tool that copies reliable markdown links to headings, finds references across the vault, and renames headings while updating links.
